title: Intro to Data Structures
description:
For a large remainder of this course, you will be building a data structure, then learning the C++ standard library implementation of it.
A data structure is a way to organize data so you can make _better algorithms_.
Here are many of the most common data structures:
- **Stack**: Last in, First out.
- **Queues**: First in, first out.
- **Linked Lists**: A chain of nodes, efficient for inserts and deletes.
- **Binary Trees**: A tree where each node has up to two children.
- **Arrays**: A contiguous block of memory.
- **Red Black Trees**: A self-balancing binary tree using colors.
- **Hashmaps**: A data structure that maps keys to values.
- **Tries**: A tree used for storing and searching words efficiently.
- **Graphs**: A collection of nodes connected by edges.
- **Heaps**: A tree of nodes where the top is biggest/smallest.
